t: A six-wheel metal robot rover with a camera, run by a Raspberry Pi.
steps: Buy a kit from Waveshare or a shop such as RobotShop. Pick a kit that includes a Raspberry Pi for the easiest start.
Buy three 18650 battery cells and charge them. They are not in the box.
Put the cells in the battery holder and switch the rover on. The microSD card in Pi kits already holds the app.
Join the rover's Wi-Fi network from your phone or laptop.
Open the web app in a browser and drive the rover around with the live camera view.
Open JupyterLab from the web app and try the color tracking notebook.
Follow the Waveshare wiki tutorials for face, gesture and line tracking.
meta: Open Board. From $295. A few stores.
